units.source_text: 明石姬等候源氏公子去后，次日适逢吉日，便赴住吉神社奉献供品。

en.t: After Lady Akashi had waited until Prince Genji departed, the next day happened to be an auspicious one, so she went to Sumiyoshi Shrine and offered gifts.

units.source_text: 这才完成了与她身份相称的祈愿。

en.t: Only then did she complete the prayers befitting her rank.

units.source_text: 然而此行反而增加了她的哀思，此后朝朝暮暮愁叹自身的不幸。

en.t: Yet the journey only deepened her sorrow, and from then on, morning and evening, she lamented her unhappy fate.

units.source_text: 有一天，算来是公子抵京后不多天，就有一个使者来到明石浦，带来公子的信，言最近即将迎接明石姬入京。

en.t: One day, not long after the prince had reached the capital, a messenger came to Akashi Bay with a letter from him, saying that he would soon bring Lady Akashi to the capital.

units.source_text: 明石姬想道：“这确是一片诚意，他对我也很重视了。

en.t: Lady Akashi thought, "This is certainly sincere, and he truly does value me.

units.source_text: 然而使不得吧，我离去此浦，到了京中，如果环境不佳，弄得进退两难，这便怎么办呢？”

en.t: And yet, surely it will not do. If I leave this shore and go to the capital, and my circumstances there are poor, leaving me unable either to advance or retreat, what am I to do then?"

units.source_text: 明石道人也觉得把女儿和外孙女放走很可担心。

en.t: The Akashi Novice, too, felt deeply anxious about letting his daughter and granddaughter go.

units.source_text: 但倘让她们埋没在这乡间，又觉得比未识源氏公子以前更加辛酸了。

en.t: But if he allowed them to remain buried in this countryside, he felt it would be even more painful than before they had ever known Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 父女二人顾虑重重，结果托使者上复公子：入京之事一时未能决定。

en.t: Father and daughter were both weighed down with concern, and in the end they asked the messenger to reply to the prince that the matter of going to the capital could not yet be decided.
